data.name: Slunk's Hardcore Overhaul (S.H.O.)
data.teaser: My Personal Overhaul To SPT Shuffling the Pistols/Shotguns/SMGs to balance the amount of weapons per caliber type. Also Made a custom APBS Loadout Preset around pistol battles to be used Making this a perfect Overhaul for a New Hardcore Playthrough
data.description:
↓↓↓↓↓ - INSTALL INSTRUCTIONS & REQUIRED MODS - ↓↓↓↓↓

Main Mod Summary

-Pistols/SMG/Shotgun Calibers have been Shuffled around to even out guns-per-caliber ratio

REALISM MEDICAL BALANCE

Adjusted med durability and other changes directly to help bridge the gap for those who found Realism Med system too difficult.

  • Surgery kits are the only way to concentrated heal an individual limbs HP over a decent time period. (like pulling bullet out) (how realism works)
  • Also limbs now come back 100% max possible HP after being Blacked-out. (my changes)
  • Surgery Kits now have a lot of HP 50-60 for more surgeries when health is low on only one limb and not enough to use drugs on (slow limb) (my changes)
  • Drugs/Pills heal the whole body over a period of time (really slowly body) (how realism works)
  • Painkillers now slowly heal the whole body over time and provide slight damage reduction (to you) followed by damage increase change chance (to you) (my change)
  • Realism, has 4 types of bleeds: Light bleed limb, Light bleed torso, Heavy bleed limb, Heavy bleed torso. (how realism works)
  • Medical packs like ‘Salewa’ are now just big bandage/tourniquet/chest-seal/Hemostatic/splint packs. (how realism works)
  • Sigle use items have been buffed to be slightly more uses (2-3). (my changes)
  • Both single use bandages can heal a heavy bleed now but consume 2HP to do so. (my changes)

APBS Custom Loadout Summary

SCAV

  • Mainly pistols/revolvers with some shotguns.
  • Low tier drip/belts with some soft armor.
  • Head protection and respirators are rare.
  • Low tier Meds.

PMC

  • Mainly pistols with Some Shotguns and SMG’s.
  • Low tier drip/belts with Plate Carriers.
  • Head/Face protection and gas masks are consistent, But no air-filters in gas masks
  • Mid to Low tier Meds

RAIDER/GUARDS

  • Mainly SMG’s & full-auto pistols with some Low tier Rifles.
  • Mid to High tier drip/belts with Plate Carriers.
  • Head/Face protection and gas masks are consistent, with gas air-filters
  • Mid to High tier Meds.

BOSSES

  • Mainly Assault Rifles with Some Special Weapons.
  • Highest tier drip/belts with Bulky Armored Vests.
  • Highest tier Head/Face protection and gas masks are consistent, with gas air-filters
  • Highest tier Meds

Install and Setup (Required Mods)

The following Mods are Required for my Overhaul to Work

1 - Choccy Milk - Beretta93

2 - Choccy Milk - KSG12

3 - Choccy Milk - Striker12

4 - Choccy Milk - Peacemaker

5 - RealMo2 - 3 SAA Cylinders - make sure this file goes in after Peacemaker or it will result in an error (they have the same name ‘choccy-saa’ so its easy to make this mistake!)

6 - GrooveypenguinX - WTT Pack ‘n’ Strap

7 - Trenchf00t - Belt Slots

8 - Trenchf00t - Scav Armbands

9 - Pluto! - Echoes of Tarkov

10 - EpicRangeTime - All in One

11 - probablyEukyre - Consortium

12 - Tron - WTT Armory

13 - AmightyTank - Masssive Soft - if you cant download version 0.2.0 then download one back 0.1.9. should work too.

14 - HaaWkk - MassiveSoft Mechanic Fix

15 - Massivesoft - Superi 46

16 - acidphantasm - APBS

17 - Fontaine - Realism

INSTRUCTIONS:

1- Download the mods listed Above and install them

2- After that just drag and drop my mod into your game directory. it will also replace the config files for APBS.

3- Please make a new character as this can potentially break your old characters inventory due to items being a different size.

4- In your SPT Launcher Go to ‘Setting -> Clean Temp Files’ this will update the Inventory Item Sprites. ALL DONE!

Special Thanks

-Thanks to the Community members that Provided the Mods used in this Overhaul.

-Thanks to HaaWkk For helping me Play test/Troubleshoot/and Generally keeping me sane during my Twitch Streams of making this mod. (Slunk_Gaming)

Future plans to do the same to Sniper Rifles and Assault Rifles and More!

CHEERS!!!!!!

versions.description:
Hot fix for compatibility with the new version of APBS 1.9.1 adding:

- Plate Class weighted selection is now available to configure (no longer hard coded)

-also fixed the spawn error for supari 46 with boss followers

-BACKPACK LOOT ON BOTS WAS SPAWNING INCORRECTLY.

-IF UPDATING FROM OLDER BUILD REPLACE REALISM CONFIG.

### **REALISM MEDICAL BALANCE** 

Adjusted med durability and other changes directly to help bridge the gap for those who found Realism Med system too difficult.

-Surgery kits are the only way to concentrated heal an individual limbs HP over a decent time period. (like pulling bullet out) (how realism works)

-Also limbs now come back 100% max possible HP after being Blacked-out. (my changes)

-Surgery Kits now have a lot of HP 50-60 for more surgeries when health is low on only one limb and not enough to use drugs on (slow limb) (my changes)

-Drugs/Pills heal the whole body over a period of time (really slowly body) (how realism works)

-Painkillers now slowly heal the whole body over time and provide slight damage reduction (to you) followed by damage increase change chance (to you) (my change)

-Realism, has 4 types of bleeds: Light bleed limb, Light bleed torso, Heavy bleed limb, Heavy bleed torso. (how realism works)

-Medical packs like 'Salewa' are now just big bandage/tourniquet/chest-seal/Hemostatic/splint packs. (how realism works)

-Sigle use items have been buffed to be slightly more uses (2-3). (my changes)

-Both single use bandages can heal a heavy bleed now but consume 2HP to do so. (my changes)

-Added the Superi 46 and 57 (THIS MOD IS NOW REQUIRED [Massivesoft - Superi 46](https://hub.sp-tarkov.com/files/file/3006-superi-46-4-6x30-smg/))

-ADDED A LOADORDER FILE TO THE MODS FOLDER TO HELP SMOOTH ERRORS

-ADDED MY OWN MEDICAL ITEM TWEAKS TO MAKE REALISM HEALING SYSTEM WHAT I CONSIDER FUN.

-MAKAROV SLIDE REAR SIGHT WAS ADDED AS IT WAS MISSING FROM WHEN BOTS SPAWN WITH IT.
